sources.coverage: 217 economy codes, 2004-2024; selected evidence uses pillars 3-5

sources.notes: Overall SPI index excluded; XKX crosswalk unresolved; pre-release retained only for revision diagnostics.

sources.coverage: Country and area census dates for the 1990, 2000, 2010, 2020, and 2030 census rounds

sources.role: Documentary census-date evidence only; not evidence of results status, coverage quality, post-enumeration surveys, undercount, adjustment, or incorporation into an estimate series
sources.citation: United Nations Statistics Division. Census dates for all countries. Last updated 3 February 2026.
sources.notes: The live HTML capture is checksum-registered but not committed. Parenthesized dates, ranges, dashes, ellipses, symbols, and footnotes require explicit parsing states; they must not be coerced to exact reference dates.

sources.dataset: Standard country or area codes for statistical use (M49) — Overview
sources.coverage: English M49 country-or-area names, M49 codes, and ISO alpha-2 and alpha-3 codes
sources.role: Country identifier crosswalk for reliability evidence; historical and subnational labels require explicit aliases or remain unmatched
sources.citation: United Nations Statistics Division. Standard country or area codes for statistical use (M49).
sources.notes: The page is live rather than release-versioned. Snapshot identity is checksum-derived. The crosswalk must not force dissolved areas or UK constituent-country census rows into present-day sovereign codes.

sources.dataset: World Urbanization Prospects 2025 Revision - Degree of Urbanization
sources.coverage: Annual population 1950-2050; land and built-up area 1975-2050
sources.unit: country or area by internationally harmonized settlement category
sources.role: National urbanization-stage controls; not an individual-city panel
sources.citation: United Nations, Department of Economic and Social Affairs, Population Division (2025). World Urbanization Prospects: The 2025 Revision, Online Edition.
sources.notes: F01-F04 are country/category tables. They cannot support individual-city hypotheses. Register exact downloads rather than assuming legacy table names.

sources.coverage: Annual estimates through 2025 and projections through 2050 for more than 12,000 cities with at least 50,000 inhabitants in 2025; area series begin in 1975
sources.unit: individual internationally harmonized city or urban settlement
sources.role: Primary city-level population, surface-area, density and growth panel
sources.citation: United Nations, Department of Economic and Social Affairs, Population Division (2025). World Urbanization Prospects: The 2025 Revision, Online Edition.
sources.notes: F21 contains cities that reach 50,000 during 1975-2050, but annual values are blank while a city is below 50,000. This is time-varying threshold truncation, not a balanced history and not selection only at 2025. Keep estimates and projections distinct. M01 documents the latest country-level population input used by the underlying GHSL grid; it does not establish direct census lineage for an individual WUP city-year.

sources.dataset: World Urbanization Prospects 2018 Revision - Urban Agglomerations
sources.coverage: Annual estimates through 2018 and projections through 2035 for 1,860 urban agglomerations reaching 300,000 inhabitants in 2018
sources.citation: United Nations, Department of Economic and Social Affairs, Population Division (2018). World Urbanization Prospects: The 2018 Revision, Online Edition.
sources.notes: This vintage uses national urban-agglomeration definitions and a 300,000-in-2018 inclusion rule. It is not definition-equivalent to WUP 2025 DEGURBA cities and cannot validate small-city results. Cross-revision comparisons require an audited geographic crosswalk and definition-agreement sensitivities.
